package com.acme.loyalty.model;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Nested;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class MemberTest {

    private Member member;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        member = new Member(1L, "ana@example.com", Tier.SILVER, 1200);
    }

    @Test
    void allArgsConstructorPopulatesFields() {
        assertThat(member.getId()).isEqualTo(1L);
        assertThat(member.getEmail()).isEqualTo("ana@example.com");
        assertThat(member.getTier()).isEqualTo(Tier.SILVER);
        assertThat(member.getPoints()).isEqualTo(1200);
    }

    @Test
    void settersOverwriteValues() {
        Member m = new Member();
        m.setId(9L);
        m.setEmail("bo@example.com");
        m.setTier(Tier.GOLD);
        m.setPoints(50);

        assertThat(m)
                .extracting(Member::getId, Member::getEmail, Member::getTier, Member::getPoints)
                .containsExactly(9L, "bo@example.com", Tier.GOLD, 50);
    }

    @Test
    void toString_isNotNull() {
        assertNotNull(member.toString());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("hashCode does not change when the id is assigned later")
    void hashCodeIsStable() {
        Member transientMember = new Member(null, "c@example.com", Tier.BRONZE, 0);
        int before = transientMember.hashCode();
        transientMember.setId(77L);
        assertThat(transientMember.hashCode()).isEqualTo(before);
    }

    @Nested
    @DisplayName("equals()")
    class Equality {

        @Test
        void sameInstanceIsEqual() {
            assertThat(member.equals(member)).isTrue();
        }

        @Test
        void notEqualToOtherTypes() {
            assertThat(member.equals("Member{id=1}")).isFalse();
        }

        @Test
        void transientMembersAreNeverEqual() {
            assertThat(new Member().equals(new Member())).isFalse();
        }

        @Test
        void equalWhenIdsMatch() {
            Member sameId = new Member(1L, "other@example.com", Tier.GOLD, 0);
            assertThat(member).isEqualTo(sameId);
        }

        @Test
        void notEqualWhenIdsDiffer() {
            assertThat(member).isNotEqualTo(new Member(2L, "ana@example.com", Tier.SILVER, 1200));
        }
    }
}
